title: One-DOF pendulum arm
subtitle: CAN 11 on the One Dof Test Rack
summary: The rack's JMC60 plate link: a JMC 60ASM200 + AD60-G10 10:1 gearmotor on a moteus r4.11, a pendulum link with ArUco tags 8-12 that a D405 watches. The model file is the station's twin of record as bam_rack_twin wrote it; the nominal values are the joint description bam_rack_twin.schedule builds CAN 11's test schedule from.

model.source: bam_rack_twin twin of record lugre-d-M1-e37b0e7d (followup A), the bare hinge bam_rack_twin.schedule build --replay wrote for CAN 11's schedule 581ffd3e

components.title: the board's motor encoder (output frame through 10:1)
D405 on tags 8-12 (the link angle after the gear)

can11.armature_kg_m2.note: the whole axis inertia of the bare hinge (TwinParameters.armature_kg_m2)

can11.frictionloss_nm.note: the friction constraint's level: the Coulomb level in M2, the static level Fs in M3 and up

can11.friction_stribeck_drop_nm.source: the description gives no Stribeck curve: M2 at its datasheet values has none

can11.friction_stribeck_speed_rad_s.source: no Stribeck curve in the description

can11.backlash_rad.source: a rigid twin: the AD60-G10 datasheet bounds backlash (<= 15 arcmin) but states no value

known.note: configuration the description states and identification does not touch (the board's own numbers, the gear split)
known.board_pid: bam_rack_twin.stations: CAN 11's output_pid() (kp 200, ki 16000, kd 4 N.m/rev, ilimit 0.5), conf get 2026-10-29
known.board_knobs: the twin of record's current_loop_hz 200, command_delay_s 0.001, current_limit (0.732 N.m/A, 4 A), hard friction solref
known.rotor_inertia_fraction_source: the record's inertia prior terms: JMC 60ASM200 rotor 1.83e-3 + gearbox input 1.3e-3 kg.m^2 at the output, of a ~0.14 kg.m^2 axis
known.output_friction_fraction_source: assumed: which side of the gap carries the friction no measurement has said (bam_rack_twin twin.py)

sensors.measures: motor-side angle and speed at the output (what the board reports)
the firmware's torque (q-current x Kt), what moteus reports
the link angle after the gear, from tags 8-12 (D405)

schedule.use: every FB run of the train split identifies; every FB run of the held-out split (H1 excite at kp x 0.5, H2 operate seeds 3-5) scores

monitoring.check: the held-out H2 operate runs under FB (pickplace, cycle, jog, sweep x seeds 3-5, 77.7 s): the motions the joint makes all day
monitoring.fidelity: link angle (the camera on tags 8-12) twin vs real, RMS over the check, divided by the floor (two noise draws of one run)
monitoring.threshold: settable (type_cards DRIFT_THRESHOLD is 1.25); here the drift ratio at which live fidelity crosses TWINNED_LIMIT x floor, so the warning means the twin has stopped being twinned
monitoring.wear: the backlash carries a linear wear law in deployment hours (type_cards Wear); its rate is fitted on the early-life checks
